name: 🎃 Da Block 💥
desc:
⭐ Use code "10KLIKES" for cash and XP Boost! Next code at 13K likes!

Welcome to Da Block. In this hood, you'll fight for money 💵, power, and respect. Use your fists, or a gun, and race cars through the streets 🚗. Start your own business and hustle your way to the top in this intense roleplay, where every move counts and the streets decide your fate 🛣️.

✅ ALL WEAPONS ARE PERMANENT

The game is currently in its Alpha stage! If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, we’d love to hear from you. Link for our community is located below.
